answer_1.quote: We evaluate EdiText's effectiveness by comparing to baselines across four tasks: toxicity control (toxifying and detoxifying text) and sentiment control (converting negative sentiment to positive and vice versa).
answer_1.outputs: edited texts with controlled attributes (e.g., toxicity, sentiment, formality)

answer_2.quote: To evaluate the generated samples from each method, we calculate the following metrics... Retention Rate... Hamming Distance... SacreBLEU... BERTScore... Reflection Rate... Moderation API... Perspective API... sentiment classifier... formality classifier.

answer_4.quote: Human Evaluation on Enron Sentiment... using Amazon Mechanical Turk... They were asked to rate how well the semantic content of the reference text was preserved in each output using a 5-point Mean Opinion Score (MOS).
answer_4.guideline: Participants rated semantic content preservation on a 5-point MOS.
